content:
If the text cell is locked or acting up, you don't have to fight it line by line. Here are two quick ways to clear it out:

Option 1 (Convert to Markdown): Click on the cell, and at the bottom toolbar of that specific cell, switch it from Python to Markdown so it safely treats the text as notes instead of code.
Option 2 (Delete the Cell): Click the delete/trash icon on the right side of that troublesome cell to wipe it entirely, then click the + or Python button to add a fresh, clean code cell.

Once you have a fresh cell, paste just this clean code block into it:
import marimo as mo
import numpy as np

def get_node_matrix():
    return np.random.randint(1, 10, size=(3, 3))

matrix_data = get_node_matrix()
spatial_grid = mo.ui.table(matrix_data.tolist())
spatial_grid
